answer: In an AI economy, the Whisper Protocol effectively resists fake-identity attacks by requiring agents to prove their identities through a cryptographic puzzle, akin to solving a marble-shaped puzzle piece. This puzzle demands agents to demonstrate a unique "digital fingerprint" or "agent signature" that can be verified by the network, rendering it impossible for an attacker to create a convincing fake identity, thereby preserving the integrity of the economy and lending credibility to the fable of a decentralized, trustless system.
